evals.name: real-app-full-review
evals.prompt: Run a product review of this app against its PRD.
files: SUPPLY: live URL (Cowork) or screenshots, plus repo access
expected_behavior: Declares evidence coverage before reviewing and ties each finding's confidence to its source
Passes the readiness gate in one line and builds a numbered ledger covering every testable PRD statement
Assigns every ledger row a status, with evidence for each status other than Delivered
Runs the reverse trace and names unaccounted features, or says the evidence could not reveal them
Uses only Blocker, Major, Minor, and Nit, consistent with rubric section B

Marks every scope finding and every PRD-level fix with PRD change, lists them in the report, and ends by offering to pass them to prd-review's grill, export issues, or stop, doing none of these unasked

evals.name: readiness-gate-stops
evals.prompt: Does the app match the spec? Here's the PRD and the repo.
expected_behavior: Stops at Step 2 without building a ledger or tracing
Names which of primary user, core job, and testable requirements fail, quoting the PRD where a passage exists
Recommends running prd-review first

evals.name: no-prd-no-review
evals.prompt: Give me a product review of this app.
files: SUPPLY: a repo with no PRD, spec, or README describing intent
expected_behavior: Searches the conversation, Project knowledge, and repo locations named in Step 1 for a PRD
Stops and asks for a PRD when none exists
Does not reconstruct intent from the code and review against it

evals.name: export-queue-needs-ruling
evals.prompt: Run a product review of this app against its PRD.
files: SUPPLY: a repo with a PRD, some gaps, and .app-review.json set to {"tracker": "markdown"}
expected_behavior: Resolves the tracker from .app-review.json without asking
Ends the report with an export queue listing every finding not written to an artifact, each with a proposed action
Writes nothing to docs/reviews/findings.md before the user rules on the queue
After a ruling such as 'export all except P-02; drop P-03, cosmetic', creates entries only for the approved findings, each with an app-review-fp line, and records P-03 as dropped with its reason
Ends with a run summary that gives every finding a state (written, exported, or dropped) and lists nothing as pending

evals.name: dedup-comments-on-existing-issue
evals.prompt: Product review again, please; we fixed a few things since last time.
files: SUPPLY: a scratch GitHub repo with .app-review.json, a PRD, and an open product-review issue whose app-review-fp line matches a gap still present
expected_behavior: Lists open product-review issues and matches fingerprints exactly before proposing any create
Proposes 'comment on #n' for the still-present gap instead of a new issue
Creates no issue whose fingerprint matches an open one
Shows a near match (same review, lens, and location, different slug) as 'same as #n?' rather than merging or duplicating it silently

evals.name: reconcile-open-entries
files: SUPPLY: a scratch GitHub repo with .app-review.json, a PRD, and three open product-review issues: one for a gap now fixed, one for a gap still present, one at a location this run's evidence cannot reach
expected_behavior: Lists open product-review and handoff:product entries before writing findings
Matches the still-present gap to its open issue and proposes a comment, not a new issue
Rechecks the fixed gap at its location and proposes 'close #n' with the evidence that shows the fix
Marks the unreachable entry unverifiable, leaves it open, and names it in the run summary
Closes nothing until the user rules on the queue

evals.name: prd-change-carries-handoff-label
evals.prompt: Product review of this app; I don't want to change the PRD today.
files: SUPPLY: a repo with .app-review.json, a PRD, and a feature the PRD does not mention
expected_behavior: Fills PRD change on the scope finding
When the user declines prd-review's grill, puts the finding in the export queue with a handoff:prd label
Counts the finding as exported, not written, in the run summary
